text: Albendazole is the best choice when Fasciola (liver fluke) infestation is suspected — risk is high when cattle graze wet areas where the snails that host the fluke's lifecycle live; it also covers lung and intestinal worms and is given orally. Dovenix was a well-known product in Cambodia, very effective against Fasciola specifically (though not other worms), given by subcutaneous injection or orally.
